kind: lossy browser rendition of the complete original edit
changes: Spatial downsample to 768x432; frame resample 30 to 24 fps; H.264 yuv420p two-pass 300 kb/s. Complete edit, original AAC and cue timeline retained. Inherited MP4 global metadata removed; faststart enabled.
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 adaptation; public-domain portions retain public-domain status
publication_note: Retain and publish the original movie and source package separately. This rendition is an additional adaptation, not the archival original.

validation.visual_review: Passed agent visual comparison of all eight side-by-side sampled frames at 15, 65, 90, 140, 240, 308, 340 and 400 seconds. Composition and visible scene content retained; expected reduced fine detail and some water/crowd texture compression. Does not establish perceptual or scientific equivalence.
validation.timing_review: Original and rendition container durations both 433.133 s; video track durations both 433.000 s; audio track durations and compressed payload identical. All eight scene intervals and crossfades retained verbatim in manifest. 30-to-24 fps conversion changes frame cadence.
validation.scientific_limit: Lossy rendition is a distinct stimulus identity. Do not pool its session results with the archival source as an identical visual stimulus without checking delivery conditions.
